root_cause: The independent exact-phone review round 29 (selected option B film c92c7a2f, option A film d5cb1aac) rejected both films again, only in the s3 creek passage (13.2 to 17.4 s). The overhead plan is accepted as legible, but the passage shows no consequence of the water: the lip is a thin pale dotted line with no white water, the shelf in the closer shot reads as a flat rounded box with straight edges, the wake strokes are ruled straight lines, the car slides off the shelf with no visible lift, it drifts about one car length with no downstream flow cue, and the qualifier 'empty' is not pictured from above (nondeferrable motion contact_and_consequence and surface_finish floors).
repair: One consolidated drawing of what the current does, in the existing overhead creek plan only. (1) A bold foam lip and white water: thick irregular foam bands along the shelf edge and a heavy foam collar that wraps the car's upstream side and builds as it floats. (2) A readable lift: when the car leaves the shelf its contact shadow separates and offsets, the car scales up slightly and the shelf-side water closes over the shelf corner. (3) Downstream flow cues: long curved current streaks and drifting foam flecks that follow the channel bend, moving visibly downstream, with the car's wake as a curved V rather than ruled straight strokes. (4) The shelf outline redrawn as an irregular hand-shaped ledge with no straight edge. (5) A longer carry (clearly more than one car length) past the fixed oak crowns and the pale ledge slab, still above the caption band. (6) The roof drawn with a glass panel through which two empty seat headrests and an empty steering wheel read, so 'empty' is pictured. Words, claims, voice, captions, timing and every other scene stay unchanged.
mechanism_change: Earlier repairs redrew banks and shelf surfaces. This repair adds a physical consequence layer to the accepted overhead plan (foam, lift separation, curved flow, longer carry) and a pictured empty cabin, which changes what the current visibly does to the car rather than how the banks are drawn.
expected_visible_result: At phone size the overhead creek shows white foam against the lip and car, the car visibly lifting off a hand-shaped ledge, curved downstream current with a curved wake, a carry of several car lengths, and visibly empty seats through the roof glass.
